drivingQuestion: Is invalid oil treated as a blemished offering for flogging?

segments.he: בָּעֵי רַבָּה: הִקְדִּישׁוֹ, מַהוּ שֶׁיִּלְקֶה עָלָיו מִשּׁוּם בַּעַל מוּם? כֵּיוָן דְּפָסוּל – כְּבַעַל מוּם דָּמֵי, אוֹ דִלְמָא אֵין בַּעַל מוּם אֶלָּא בִּבְהֵמָה? תֵּיקוּ.
segments.en: «Rava asks:» If one «consecrated» one of these unfit oils for use in meal offerings, «what is» the halakha with regard to whether «he should be flogged for» consecrating «it due to» the prohibition against consecrating «a flawed» item as an offering? Does one say that «since it» is «unfit,» it is «comparable to a blemished» animal? «Or perhaps» the prohibition against consecrating «a flawed» item «applies only to an animal.» The Gemara concludes: The dilemma «shall stand» unresolved.
